```{r}

# summarise() can tell you this

# let's instead reformat these columns so all values are the same type
# we can do that using a combination of as.numeric() and str_remove_all() on the FavTemp column



# in the Pets column, let's use a combination of mutate() and str_remove_all() again to remove any responses that aren't numeric. we'll again make this column as.numeric() as well.
```
